title: Return a result
summary: Lua: Return a result. Call twice(7). Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: A function is a named group of steps. return sends a value back.

blocks.text: Install Lua 5.3 or 5.4. Save each example as lesson.lua and run lua lesson.lua.

blocks.title: Return a result
blocks.code:
local function twice(n)
 return n * 2
end
print(twice(4))

blocks.text: The function input n receives 4. return sends 8 to the outer print.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Close the function with end before calling it.
